tasks.description: Add a pure filterTasks(tasks, query, status) function in src/tasks.js. Keep task data and localStorage unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Trim the query and match title or description without case sensitivity; an empty query matches all tasks.
Support All, todo, doing, and done status selections and combine status with the query.
Return a new task array without mutating input tasks or persisting filter state.

tasks.description: Add deterministic tests for the pure filter function in the existing model test file.
acceptance_criteria: Cover title match, description match, case handling, trimmed and empty queries, combined status filtering, and no match.
Verify the input task array and task objects are not mutated; npm test passes.

tasks.description: Add accessible search and status controls above the board and connect them to the pure filter in src/app.js.
acceptance_criteria: Show a search field and All, To do, Doing, Done status options above the board.
Changing either control updates visible tasks; clearing both restores the full board without changing stored tasks.
Existing create, edit, move, delete, and reload behavior continues to work while filters are active.

tasks.description: Update rendering to show visible-task counts per column and a clear message when filters match no tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Each column count reflects only visible tasks, including zero.
A clear empty-result message appears for no matches and disappears when results return.
npm test and both Node syntax checks pass.
